name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for trip hazard removal?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for trip hazard removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for trip hazard removal, prioritize experience, especially with interior structural and finishing work. Look for contractors who offer detailed assessments and transparent proposals, outlining the scope of work, materials, and costs. Check for proper licensing, insurance, and positive client testimonials or references. A good contractor will also communicate clearly, adhere to schedules, and ensure the work meets safety standards and aesthetic expectations. Asking about their warranty or guarantee on workmanship is also advisable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, transparent proposals, proper licensing and insurance, positive references, and clear communication.
